entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup` env show and `env set` unclearly report a saved setting rather than the reality of `PATH` #57189
  • `dotnetup` should not rely on `$SHELL` for the default shell #57188
  • `get-dotnetup` scripts could add `dotnetup` to the PATH #57187
  • SDK 10.0.115 workload clean removes VS-managed .NET 11 MAUI packages without --all and exits successfully #57171
  • IDE0028 for collections with constructor arguments #57170
  • [Known Build Error] PersistentStorageTelemetryE2ETests.ItPersistsTraceTelemetryToTheStorageDirectory fails: trace telemetry not persisted #57169
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With NET 12.0.100-alpha SDK installed, the size of total published folder for Blazorwasm with AOT enable is the same with AOT disable. #57167

Closed

  • dotnet publish fails when publish directory has a semi-colon #49671
    11.0.1xx
  • [Known Build Error] F# sample template snapshot mismatch after unversioned package update #57031
  • IsHidden on HostSpecificTemplateData for CLI #40259
  • `dotnet new --no-update-check` does not suppress Optional workloads provider notice #55386
    Backlog
  • Release-property discovery evaluates shared projects and prints missing CodeSharing imports #57116
  • .NET 11 installer should abort installation if minimum hardware requirements are not met #57150
  • dotnetup: install to user-local location when `$host$` is in `global.json`'s `sdk.paths` #54658
  • Separate shell profile setup from broader environment-configuration logic in dotnetup init #53964
  • dotnetup: Update `defaultinstall` command to set path preference #53742
  • Visual studio changes Targets on unrelated projects on modifying a .slnx #57166
  • dotnet tool list command show nothing on Mac #28724
  • MSB4018: System.IO.EndOfStreamException #28734
  • DNUP Self Update Mechanism #50607
  • `dotnetup` self update should notify `preview` customers of available update #55585
  • Document Commands for dotnetup #50617

PullRequests

Created

  • extend CA2259 to attributes with no effect #57190
  • `dotnetup` shouldn't fail for invalid `global.json` if one is not required and should fail clearly if it is required and invalid #57186
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57185
  • Increase local trace telemetry persistence budget #57184
  • Add analyzer for mismatched EventSource event IDs #57183
  • Gate dotnet test --solution device selection on IsTestingPlatformApplication only #57182
  • Remove ASP.NET test net11 transition workarounds #57181
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Pin template engine samples package #57180
    Blocked
  • Fix UpToDate_ArtifactsRelocated flakiness from automatic cleanup on Windows #57179
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Disable NuGet audit in SDK test processes #57177
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Pin Microsoft.TemplateEngine.Samples in samples test #57176
  • Stop forwarding SDK location defaults to MSBuild #57174
    Area-MSBuild, Area-dotnet AOT
  • add CA1883: prefer Dictionary.Remove(key, out value) over TryGetValue followed by Remove #57173
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57172
  • Use ORAS.NET for container registry operations #57168
  • Delete a workload command's temp directory when its constructor throws #57165
  • Preserve colons in multi-architecture container environment variables #57164

Merged

  • Escape literal output paths before forwarding to MSBuild #56972
    breaking-change
  • Honor --no-update-check for built-in template availability notices #56975
  • Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 5 updates #57084
    dependencies, github_actions
  • Update implicit versions for November 2026 #57050
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Disable NuGet audit in SDK test processes #57178
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Test the in-repo TemplateEngine samples instead of the published package #57175
    Servicing-consider
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57118
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Unify dotnetup repository requirements and install-spec resolution #56798
  • Skip shared projects in release property discovery #57117
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Keep Web SDK browser tools local to their project #57153
    Servicing-approved

Updated

  • Plumb cancellation through CLI commands and add phased shutdown #56332
  • Enhance `dotnetup` `--no-progress` and add hookable json object progress reporting #57012
  • Simplify dotnetup uninstall to remove command-line requirements #56799

    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Preserve published tool packages when metadata publication fails #56862
    Servicing-approved
  • Generate SDK layout apphosts incrementally #56764
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Serialize concurrent tool package installations #56861
    Servicing-approved
  • add CA2030: do not use ReferenceEquals with unrelated types #57082
